response_property_constraints.description: When present, each business's price must be one of the enumerated currency-symbol price tiers: 1 to 4 repetitions of '$', '£', '€' or '¥'.
When present, each business's rating must be a number between 1 and 5 inclusive.
Each entry in a business's transactions array must be one of 'pickup', 'delivery' or 'restaurant_reservation'.

request_response_constraints.description: When the request parameter 'radius' (search radius in meters) is provided, every returned business must have a distance that does not exceed the radius.
request_response_constraints.corresponding_attribute_description: Integer search radius (maximum 40000); no textual description given in the spec.

request_response_constraints.description: When the request parameter 'price' is provided (price tiers 1-4, possibly comma-separated), every returned business that has a price must have a price symbol string whose length equals one of the requested tiers.
request_response_constraints.corresponding_attribute_description: Array of price tiers (1, 2, 3, 4), form-style, not exploded; no textual description given in the spec.

response_property_constraints.description: The hotelId must be an Amadeus Property Code of exactly 8 characters, using only uppercase letters and digits (^[A-Z0-9]{8}$).
The chainCode must be an Amadeus 2-character code made of two uppercase letters (^[A-Z]{2}$).
The cityCode must be an IATA city code of exactly three uppercase letters (^[A-Z]{3}$).
The offer id must be 2 to 100 characters long and contain only uppercase letters and digits (^[A-Z0-9]*$).
The check-in date must be a valid date in the format YYYY-MM-DD.
The check-out date must be a valid YYYY-MM-DD date and its lowest accepted value is checkInDate+1, so it must be later than the check-in date of the same offer.
The rateCode must be a 3-character provider rate code consisting of uppercase letters, digits or '*' (^[A-Z0-9*]{3}$).

The boardType must be one of the allowed board type values (ROOM_ONLY, BREAKFAST, HALF_BOARD, FULL_BOARD, ALL_INCLUSIVE, BUFFET_BREAKFAST, CARIBBEAN_BREAKFAST, CONTINENTAL_BREAKFAST, ENGLISH_BREAKFAST, FULL_BREAKFAST, DINNER_BED_AND_BREAKFAST, LUNCH, DINNER, FAMILY_PLAN, AS_BROCHURED, SELF_CATERING, BERMUDA, AMERICAN, FAMILY_AMERICAN, MODIFIED).
The room type code must be a 3-character identifier of uppercase letters, digits or '*' (^[A-Z0-9*]{3}$).
The estimated number of beds in the room must be an integer between 1 and 9.
The number of adult guests per room must be an integer between 1 and 9.
The rate type must be one of P (public), N (negotiated) or C (conditional).
The paymentType must be one of GUARANTEE, DEPOSIT, PREPAY, HOLDTIME or their lowercase equivalents.
The cancellation deadline must be an ISO 8601 date-time (e.g. 2010-08-14T12:00:00+01:00 or 2010-08-14T12:00:00Z).
Each accepted payment card type must be a 2-character code of uppercase letters (^[A-Z]{2}$).

Each accepted payment method must be one of the allowed Method values (CREDIT_CARD, AGENCY_ACCOUNT, TRAVEL_AGENT_ID, CORPORATE_ID, HOTEL_GUEST_ID, CHECK, MISC_CHARGE_ORDER, ADVANCE_DEPOSIT, COMPANY_ADDRESS, VCC_BILLBACK, VCC_B2B_WALLET, DEFERED_PAYMENT, TRAVEL_AGENT_IMMEDIATE).
The tax pricingFrequency must be either PER_STAY or PER_NIGHT.
The tax pricingMode must be either PER_OCCUPANT or PER_PRODUCT.
Each price variation startDate must be a valid date in the format YYYY-MM-DD.
Each price variation endDate must be a valid date in the format YYYY-MM-DD.
The commission percentage must be a numeric value between 0 and 100.

request_response_constraints.description: When the request parameter 'boardType' is provided, every returned offer that has a boardType must have a boardType equal to the requested value.
request_response_constraints.corresponding_attribute_description:
Filter response based on available meals:
        * ROOM_ONLY = Room Only
        * BREAKFAST = Breakfast
        * HALF_BOARD = Diner & Breakfast (only for Aggregators)
        * FULL_BOARD = Full Board (only for Aggregators)
        * ALL_INCLUSIVE = All Inclusive (only for Aggregators)

request_response_constraints.description: When the request parameter 'checkInDate' is provided, every returned offer must have a checkInDate equal to the requested date.
request_response_constraints.corresponding_attribute_description: Check-in date of the stay (hotel local date). Format YYYY-MM-DD. The lowest accepted value is the present date (no dates in the past). If not present, the default value will be today's date in the GMT time zone.

request_response_constraints.description: When the request parameter 'checkOutDate' is provided, every returned offer must have a checkOutDate equal to the requested date.
request_response_constraints.corresponding_attribute_description: Check-out date of the stay (hotel local date). Format YYYY-MM-DD. The lowest accepted value is checkInDate+1. If not present, it will default to checkInDate +1.

request_response_constraints.description: When the request parameter 'adults' is provided, every returned offer must have guests.adults equal to the requested number of adults per room.
request_response_constraints.corresponding_attribute_description: Number of adult guests (1-9) per room.

request_response_constraints.description: When the request parameter 'hotelIds' is provided, every returned hotel's hotelId must be one of the requested Amadeus property codes.
request_response_constraints.corresponding_attribute_description: Amadeus property codes on 8 chars. Mandatory parameter for a search by predefined list of hotels.

request_response_constraints.description: When the request parameter 'roomQuantity' is provided, any returned offer that reports a roomQuantity must have a value equal to the requested number of rooms.

When the request parameter 'paymentPolicy' is GUARANTEE, DEPOSIT, the returned offers must have a paymentType equal (case-insensitively) to the requested value; NONE means all types and is not constrained.
request_response_constraints.corresponding_attribute_description: Filter the response based on a specific payment type. NONE means all types (default).

response_property_constraints.description: The object type of the playlist must be the string 'playlist'.
The object type of the playlist owner (user profile) must be the string 'user'.
The Spotify URI of the playlist must have the format 'spotify:playlist:<id>' and its id part must match the playlist id.
The Spotify URI of the playlist owner must have the format 'spotify:user:<id>' and match the owner id.
The snapshot_id is a version identifier and must be a non-empty string.
The href must be a valid HTTP(S) URL linking to the Web API endpoint of the playlist.
The Spotify external URL of the playlist must be a valid HTTP(S) URL.
The total number of followers must be a non-negative integer.
The total number of tracks must be a non-negative integer and at least the number of items returned in the page.
The number of items returned in the tracks page must not exceed the page limit.
The offset of the returned tracks must be a non-negative integer.

request_response_constraints.description: The playlist is created for the user identified by the path parameter user_id, so the owner id in the response must equal that user_id.

response_body.Title: The Godfather
response_body.Actors: Marlon Brando, Al Pacino, James Caan
response_body.Plot: The aging patriarch of an organized crime dynasty in postwar New York City transfers control of his clandestine empire to his reluctant youngest son.

response_property_constraints.description: The Response field must be one of the enumerated string values 'True' or 'False'.
The Poster field, when not 'N/A', must be a valid URI starting with http:// or https://.
The imdbID must be a valid IMDb ID: the prefix 'tt' followed by digits (e.g. tt0000001).
The Type field must be one of 'movie', 'series' or 'episode'.
The Year field must be a four-digit year, optionally followed by a dash and an end year for series (e.g. '2008–2013' or '2019–'), or 'N/A'.
The Released field must be a date formatted as 'DD Mon YYYY' (e.g. '12 Jun 2013'), or 'N/A'.
The DVD field must be a date formatted as 'DD Mon YYYY' (e.g. '01 Oct 2013'), or 'N/A'.
The Runtime field must be a number of minutes formatted as '<integer> min' (e.g. '107 min'), or 'N/A'.
The Metascore field must be an integer between 0 and 100 (as a string), or 'N/A'.
The imdbRating field must be a decimal number between 0 and 10 (as a string), or 'N/A'.
The imdbVotes field must be an integer with comma thousands separators (e.g. '370,080'), or 'N/A'.
The BoxOffice field must be a dollar amount with comma thousands separators (e.g. '$96,200,000'), or 'N/A'.

request_response_constraints.description: When the request parameter 'type' is provided, the returned Type must equal that value.
When the request parameter 'i' is provided, the returned imdbID must equal that IMDb ID.
When the request parameter 'y' is provided, the returned Year must match that release year (equal to it, or a series range that includes it).

response_property_constraints.description: The kind field must be the fixed string 'youtube#videoListResponse'.
The kind field of every item must be the fixed string 'youtube#video'.

pageInfo.resultsPerPage is the number of results included in the API response, so it must equal the number of items returned. pageInfo.totalResults is the total number of results in the result set, so it must be at least resultsPerPage.
actualStartTime, actualEndTime, scheduledStartTime and scheduledEndTime in liveStreamingDetails must be valid date-time (RFC 3339) strings.
The actual end time of a broadcast must not be earlier than its actual start time.

request_response_constraints.description: When the request parameter 'id' is provided (comma-separated list of video IDs), every video returned in items must have an id that is among the requested ids.
request_response_constraints.corresponding_attribute_description: Return videos with the given ids.

request_response_constraints.description: When the request parameter 'id' is provided, the number of returned items must not exceed the number of distinct requested ids.
request_response_constraints.corresponding_attribute_description: Return videos with the given ids.

request_response_constraints.description: When the request parameter 'part' includes liveStreamingDetails, the returned video resources may contain only the requested parts; so no other optional parts (e.g., snippet, statistics, contentDetails) may be present in the items beyond kind, etag, id and the requested parts.
request_response_constraints.corresponding_attribute_description: The *part* parameter specifies a comma-separated list of one or more video resource properties that the API response will include. If the parameter identifies a property that contains child properties, the child properties will be included in the response. For example, in a video resource, the snippet property contains the channelId, title, description, tags, and categoryId properties. As such, if you set *part=snippet*, the API response will contain all of those properties.

response_property_constraints.description: The code field is the HTTP status code of the returned result, so it must be an integer in the valid HTTP status code range 100-599.
The count field is the total number of results returned by this call, so it must equal the number of elements in the results array.

The total field is the total number of resources available given the current filter set, so it must be at least the number of results returned (count). The offset must not be negative, and count must not exceed the requested limit.
For the creators list, 'available' must be greater than or equal to 'returned', 'returned' is at most 20, and 'returned' must equal the number of entries in 'items'.
For the characters list, 'available' must be greater than or equal to 'returned', 'returned' is at most 20, and 'returned' must equal the number of entries in 'items'.
For the stories list, 'available' must be greater than or equal to 'returned', 'returned' is at most 20, and 'returned' must equal the number of entries in 'items'.
For the events list, 'available' must be greater than or equal to 'returned', 'returned' is at most 20, and 'returned' must equal the number of entries in 'items'.
Each url value must be a full URL including scheme, domain, and path (starting with http:// or https://).
The language field must be an IETF language tag (e.g. 'en-us'): an alphabetic primary subtag of 2-3 letters followed by optional hyphen-separated alphanumeric subtags.
Each price is expressed in USD and must be a non-negative number.
The digitalId is the ID of the digital representation of the comic and will be 0 if the comic is not available digitally, so it must be a non-negative integer.

request_response_constraints.description: The comic fetched by comicId must be the one requested, so every returned comic's id must equal the comicId path parameter.

The Poster field, when not 'N/A', must be a valid URI starting with http:// or https://.
The Type field of each search item must be one of the values 'movie', 'series' or 'episode'.
The imdbID field of each search item must be an IMDb identifier: 'tt' followed by digits.
The Year field of each search item must be a four-digit year (optionally a range like 2010–2015 for series).
